test_flatten_json_noop: test that flatten returns JSON-compatible objects unchanged including strings numbers dicts and lists
test_restore_json_noop: test that restore returns JSON-compatible objects unchanged including unicode strings and booleans
test_serialize_non_str_keys: test that flatten and restore round-trip dicts with integer keys correctly
test_serialize_numpy_arrays: test that flatten and restore preserve numpy array values dtype and shape
test_serialize_tuples: test that flatten and restore round-trip tuples and preserve tuple type
